description: Tooltip — the floating hint, NEGATIVE: an inverse panel (near-black on light, near-white on dark) via the bg-inverse/text-on-inverse concept tokens, as EDS 1.x had it. Height emerges from the recipe: xs inset × 2 + cap(sm label). Twelve placements (side × start/center/end) — the full EDS 1.0 arrow fan, kept because product teams use all of it. PLACEMENT names where the TOOLTIP sits relative to its ANCHOR — the arrow points back at the anchor (Placement=Top: bubble above the target, arrow on the bubble's bottom edge). Same convention as Floating UI, CSS anchor positioning and EDS 1.0 (Popper). On a bare canvas this reads inverted; snap an instance to its target and it is right.
notes: v0.1 shipped as a light floating surface (bg-floating + elevation-low) — overruled by Victor 2026-08-29: tooltips are negative, and the December set simply lacked the words for it. bg-inverse/text-on-inverse were added as concept tokens (palette steps 13/15, additive like the ghost ladder) rather than binding the emphasis fill, which is step 9 — a mid fill, nowhere near black. The arrow derives: width = the label's cap box, protrusion = half of it, so it scales with density like everything else (no arrow-size token). Placement names where the TOOLTIP sits relative to the anchor; the arrow renders on the opposite edge, pointing at the anchor. Positioning the floating layer itself is the consumer's job (popover + CSS anchor positioning is the intended pairing — see design-system-css autocomplete for prior art); this contract owns the bubble and the arrow.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the tooltip sits relative to its anchor; the arrow renders opposite, pointing at the anchor.
